title: Sell-through % and slow-seller flags
objective: Calculate sell-through % safely and flag slow sellers.
instructions: Columns B and C hold pairs sold and pairs on hand for six styles. In D2:D7 calculate the sell-through %: sold divided by (sold plus on hand), multiplied by 100, rounded to 1 decimal place with ROUND. If a style has no stock at all, use IFERROR to show 0 instead of an error. In E2:E7 show "Slow" when the sell-through is below the limit in G2, otherwise "OK".
hints: Start with the plain formula: =B2/(B2+C2)*100. Then wrap it in ROUND(...,1).
Wrap the whole thing in IFERROR(...,0) so a style with no stock shows 0.
For the flag use =IF(D2<$G$2,"Slow","OK") and copy it down. The $ signs keep the limit cell fixed.
